note: §4.2 requires every metric shown on the site to resolve to a one-sentence definition AND a statement of what a good value looks like. The glossary is a real page, not a tooltip. TPRR and route participation are absent deliberately — both need a routes-run denominator that no open source publishes.

data.definition: High-value touches per game: all targets plus carries inside the opponent 10, divided by games played.
data.good: NEEDS CONFIRMATION — the definition above reads 'inside the opponent 10' as modifying carries only, which is the conventional usage. Confirm before publishing.

data.definition: A player's targets as a percentage of his team's total targets while he was active.
data.good: Above 25% is a clear number one option; above 30% is among the league's most concentrated roles.

data.definition: A player's intended air yards as a percentage of his team's total, measuring how much of the downfield passing game runs through him.
data.good: Above 35% indicates the offence's primary vertical threat.

data.definition: Weighted opportunity rating, combining target share and air yards share into one measure of receiving opportunity.
data.good: Displayed on this site as its two components rather than only the composite, because the same WOPR can describe a possession role and a vertical one.

data.definition: Rushing yards gained before contact versus after it, separating the blocking environment from the runner.
data.good: A high YBC with a low YAC points at the offensive line; the reverse points at the back.

data.definition: The points a team is expected to score, derived from the game total and the spread.
data.good: Above 26 is a strong scoring environment; below 18 suppresses every skill position in the game.
